summary.en: Before it approaches, check the information, bring in things on the balcony that could blow away, charge your phone and get your supplies ready. During strong wind and rain, do not go out unless you must, and do not go to look at rivers or the sea. Decide whether to evacuate from the city's evacuation information and the hazard map. Avoid moving once it has become dangerous.
